events.title: Canada Goose (GOOS) Misses Q4 Earnings Estimates
events.body: Canada Goose (GOOS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -6.90% and +10.95%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Boot Barn Stock to Post Q4 Earnings: What Investors Should Know?
events.body: BOOT's Q4 results are likely to benefit from strong western wear demand, digital growth and continued store expansion momentum.

events.title: 3 Apparel Stocks With the Right Setup to Beat Earnings This Season
events.body: FIGS, GAP and CPRI enter the earnings season with strong momentum, margin discipline and positive ESPs, signaling potential earnings surprises.
